title: 汉语数量与英语名词形式
goal: 能根据语境判断名词的可数性，并选择符合数量的形式。

points.label: 判断原文名词在语境中的可数性
选择符合数量含义的名词形式

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 翻译教学所依据的大纲

body.p: 汉语名词的形式通常不随数量改变。英语要根据名词的可数性和语境中的数量选择形式。

body.box:
原文：游客在展厅里参观了三件传统工艺品。
译文：Visitors viewed three traditional crafts in the exhibition hall.

body.p: three 后用复数 crafts。汉语没有复数词尾，译成英语时要用复数表示多个。

cards.title: 可数名词
rows: The park has two facilities for visitors.
Visitors use the path beside the lake.
Local traditions include making paper lanterns.
The village has three old buildings.
A garden stands beside the library.
The community celebrates a local festival.

cards.title: 不可数名词
rows: The guide provides information about the site.
The guide gives visitors useful advice.
Farmers grow rice in the valley.
The shop sells tea from the hills.

cards.title: 数量与量词
rows: 游客通常沿着湖边步道参观这座公园。
Visitors usually tour the park along the lakeside path. visitors 泛指游客。
这个村庄保存着两座历史悠久的石桥。
The village preserves two historic stone bridges. two 后接复数。
工匠使用木材制作适合日常使用的器具。
Craftspeople use wood to make objects for daily use. wood 表示木材。
展板上提供了一条关于古桥的信息。
The panel provides a piece of information about the old bridge. piece 表示一条。
工作人员搬进了三件新的家具。
Staff moved in three pieces of new furniture. pieces 表示三件。

body.box:
原文：工作人员为游客提供了两条有用的信息。
1. Staff provided visitors with two useful informations.
2. Staff provided visitors with two pieces of useful information.
3. Staff provided visitors with a piece of useful information.
4. Staff provided visitors with two useful pieces of equipment.

body.p: information 不可数。第二项用 two pieces of 保留两条这一数量。

items.stem: 原文：导览图为游客提供有关展馆的信息。Which noun is uncountable in the translation?
items.why: information 表示信息，通常不可数。

items.stem: 原文：公园新建了三座供游客休息的亭子。Which phrase preserves the number?
items.why: three 后接可数名词复数 pavilions。

items.stem: 原文：工匠使用木材制作小型家具。Which translation treats the material as uncountable?
options: Craftspeople use a wood to make small furniture.
Craftspeople use woods to make a small furniture.
Craftspeople use wood to make small furniture.
Craftspeople use two woods to make small furnitures.
items.why: wood 表示木材，furniture 表示家具，均用不可数形式。

items.stem: 原文：工作人员为展室添置了两件新家具。Which phrase expresses the quantity?
items.why: two pieces of 表示两件，furniture 保持不可数形式。

groups.text: 原文：村里的小展馆收藏传统工艺品。展馆有两间展室，还为游客提供关于工艺的信息。

items.stem: Which phrase translates 两间展室?
items.why: 两间用 two 修饰复数 rooms。

items.stem: Which phrase expresses the information provided?
items.why: 原文是关于工艺的信息。information 不可数，不加 -s，前面也不用 an，即第二项。

items.stem: 原文：工作人员提供了有关村庄的实用信息。Which phrase expresses the information naturally?
options: a useful information about the village
items.why: 原文是有关村庄的信息。information 不可数，第一项用原形，也没有加 a。

items.stem: 原文：公园为游客提供了三个休息设施。Which phrase preserves the number?
options: three pieces of rest facility for visitors
items.why: 原文是三个休息设施。facility 可数，three 后接复数 facilities，即第二项。

items.stem: 原文：工匠用木材制作了供展览的桌子。Which translation uses the material noun correctly?
options: Craftspeople made a table for the exhibition from a wood.
Craftspeople made furniture for the exhibition from two woods.
Craftspeople made a table for the exhibition from wood.
Craftspeople made tables for the exhibition from woods.
items.why: 原文的木材指材料，wood 不可数，前面不加 a，也不加 -s。第三项用了不可数形式。

items.stem: 原文：展室内放置了两件古老的木制家具。Which phrase expresses the stated quantity?
options: one piece of old wooden furniture
two old wooden pieces of equipment
two pieces of old wooden furniture
items.why: two pieces of 表示两件，furniture 保持不可数形式。

items.stem: 原文：这个小镇保存着两座古老的石桥。Arrange the given translation.
items.why: two 后接 bridges，old stone 修饰桥。

items.stem: 原文：导览图提供了一条有关古桥的信息。Arrange the given translation.
items.why: a piece of information 表示一条信息。

items.stem: 原文：展馆收藏着三件传统工艺品。The gallery holds three traditional ___. Complete with the plural of craft.
原文：展馆为访客提供了设备。The gallery provides visitors with ___. Complete with the uncountable noun equipment.
items.why: equipment 表示设备，使用不可数形式。
